verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs hint at knowledge ingestion (auto-detecting knowledge gaps and drafting content from past agent resolutions, integrations with no custom code) but there is no explicit documentation describing ingestion of help center content, past tickets, and internal wikis as unified knowledge sources without manual re-authoring. Missing for 10: explicit connector list for docs/tickets/wikis, description of automatic knowledge-base sync, and independent confirmation of no manual re-authoring being required.
